summary: First full E2E run of Noexis TMS. Backend: 12 pytest tests (auth, vehicles CRUD, dispatch + gender lock, seat conflict, round trip occupying go+return, unassign, trips lifecycle + duplicate rejection + booking completion rules, driver portal, student register/approve/book/cancel, role 403s, stats) - 11/12 pass. Frontend (Playwright): admin login -> /admin with stats, add/edit vehicle, create bookings via dialog with Leaflet map click + new university, dispatch male row1 then female sees row1 seat locked (disabled), assign row2, unassign by clicking occupied seat (confirm), create trip (occupancy 2/8, passengers, Google Maps/Waze/full-route links with coordinates), duplicate trip toast, driver mobile login -> /driver start/complete, bookings became completed, student register -> pending login blocked -> admin approves in Students tab -> student logs in, creates round booking, cancels it, route guards redirect student/driver/logged-out correctly. All passed.

minor.issue: Changing plate to one already used by another vehicle returns 500 (pymongo DuplicateKeyError from unique index) instead of 400. add_vehicle checks duplicates but update_vehicle does not.

Brute-force lockout ineffective in this deployment: identifier is request.client.host + phone, and client.host varies per ingress pod (6 bad attempts -> all 401, never 429; DB record showed count=3 for one IP). Use X-Forwarded-For first IP or key by phone only. Also once 'until' expires the count is not reset, so the next single failure re-locks immediately.
Changing driver_phone leaves the old driver user account active (can still log in, but sees no trips); upsert_driver also renames any existing driver with that phone.
No server-side validation of pickup_time range (06:00-19:00) or date format; any string accepted.
Unauthenticated endpoint creates new universities (ensure_university) - anyone can pollute the university list.
No state transition validation (pending->completed directly, completed->pending allowed).

design_issues.screen: Bookings filter, Dispatch view date, Trips form/filter, Booking dialog
issues: Native browser date/time pickers (input type=date/time, shows mm/dd/yyyy LTR) instead of shadcn Calendar - inconsistent with Arabic RTL UI
today() uses UTC (toISOString) - in Iraq (UTC+3) between 00:00-03:00 local, default date and driver 'today' highlight show yesterday

action_items: update_vehicle: check plate uniqueness excluding current vehicle (return 400) to avoid 500
Fix login lockout identifier (use X-Forwarded-For or phone) and reset count after lock window expires
Optional: validate pickup_time within 06:00-19:00 and date format in BookingIn/StudentBookingIn
Optional: replace native date inputs with shadcn Calendar/Popover; use local date for today()
critical_code_review_comments: Auth uses Bearer token in localStorage (no httpOnly cookie) - accepted by design per E1 note; CORS allow_credentials=False with '*' default is consistent with that.
bcrypt hash verified starts with $2b$; seed admin only inserted if missing (does not overwrite password) - OK.
No delete endpoints for users/universities - test-created student/driver users and TEST_ universities remain in DB.
delete_vehicle does not deactivate the driver user account.
Trip passengers are ordered by pickup_time; with equal times order is arbitrary - consider secondary sort by seat.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ vehicles/bookings/trips (deleted by id afterwards). Remaining (no delete API): driver users 079xxxxxxx/0790000111, student users 077xxxxxxx/0775550123 (TEST_Student, TEST_UI_Student), universities TEST_Uni*, TEST_UI_University.
